description: This file contains pytest test cases for a FastAPI application, including tests for creating items, reading items, and retrieving the OpenAPI schema. It utilizes fixtures, dynamic module import, and FastAPI's TestClient to validate API responses.

methods.name: TestClient get_client(request: pytest.FixtureRequest)
methods.description: Pytest fixture that dynamically imports a module based on request parameters, creates a FastAPI TestClient instance, and provides it for tests.

methods.name: None test_create_item(client: TestClient)
methods.description: Test case that sends a POST request to create an item and asserts the response status and content.

methods.name: None test_read_items(client: TestClient)
methods.description: Test case that retrieves the list of items and asserts the response status and JSON content.

methods.name: None test_openapi_schema(client: TestClient)
methods.description: Test case that retrieves the OpenAPI JSON schema and asserts its correctness.
